dedupe_keys.name: bayesian belief network model data sets for seismic damage assessment of masonry buildings

description: Antonio Fumai and colleagues publish a Bayesian belief network for seismic damage assessment of masonry buildings. The July 2026 deposit contains a Netica NETA model and three Excel workbooks, freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Training and independent testing tables contain post-earthquake observations of building characteristics, vulnerability parameters, shaking intensity and damage levels. A separate workbook defines the conditional probability tables. These materials can reproduce probabilistic damage inference or calibrate regional building-risk simulations. The public metadata do not identify all earthquake locations, survey periods, sample sizes or Netica-version requirements, so geographic transferability remains uncertain. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this model. The workbooks and model were not downloaded or executed, and the claimed separation between training and testing observations was not independently audited.
